Upodghātaniryukti(uvagghāyanijjutti)
Jain. Pkt. 216 verses; part of Āvaśyakaniryukti. BORI. 273 (h), 306 (f) of Ā882-83. 615 (a. of 1884-86. 1347 (i) of 1891-95. BORI. D. XVII. iii. 1032-1035. D. p.. 325. 329. Peters. I. p. 124 (no. 273 (10)). p. 127 (no. 306 (6)).

Upodghātavinirṇaya
the eighth Prakaraṇa of Nayadyumaṇi. See MD. 4907.

Upoṣathaśīlavibhāviniya
a compilation of Pāli texts on the observances of the Uposathadays, with C.s in Sinhalese by Saraṇatissa. [Page388-b]
Pt.. Colombo, 1888. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 373.

Uposathasutta
with a. ancient Sinhalese verbal explanation.
Pt.. Colombo, 1891. Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 435.

Uposadhāvadāna
Bud. Skt. on the fast Uposadha or Posadha. AS. p. 244. Cabaton I. 155. Cambr. Uni. Bud. p.. 135. 137. 139. Hod. Bud. 15. Nepal II. p. 159. SBL. Nepal. p. 265.
